resources.string: Support OpenSAAB · Buy me a beer

I’ve put my own time into bringing OpenSAAB to life. If it helps you, consider buying me a beer or supporting development. Contributions help fund adapter testing, documentation and ongoing work.\n\nSupport is voluntary. It does not unlock features, purchase vehicle security access or guarantee compatibility. Testing, documentation and code contributions are welcome too.
Continue opens the project’s donation page in your browser. No vehicle data or diagnostic logs are added to the link.
